description: Change a credential, by the id from list_credentials: its name, its value, or who may read it — each on its own, and only what you pass is touched, so taking somebody off the list never needs the value. 'readers' REPLACES the list; noReaders: true empties it. Only the person who attached it and the project's lead may change one: being shown a secret is not being given it to pass on. The answer never carries the value. Do not repeat the value in any text you write — a comment, a description, a merge request, a log.

name.description: A new name. Leave it out to keep the name.

noReaders.description: True to leave nobody on the list — the author and the project's lead still read it.

readers.description: Who else may read it from now on, comma-separated usernames or emails. Replaces the whole list. Leave it out to keep the list.

value.description: A new value. Leave it out to keep the value.

name: update_credential
